author: Al Jazeera English
description:
The United States Central Command (CENTCOM) has announced plans to enforce a naval blockade targeting maritime traffic to and from Iranian ports, escalating tensions in an already fragile region.

According to officials, the blockade will apply to vessels entering or leaving Iranian ports across the Arabian Gulf and Gulf of Oman, while allowing freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz for ships not linked to Iran.

Meanwhile, Iran’s Revolutionary Guard (IRGC) has issued a strong warning, stating that military vessels must stay away and vowing a firm response to any unauthorized presence. The announcement follows failed negotiations between the US and Iran, raising concerns over legality, global trade disruption, and potential escalation.

With China—Iran’s largest trade partner—closely watching, questions remain about the global impact and the risk of further conflict.

author: Al Jazeera English
description:
Saudi Arabia's energy ministry has announced that it has restored full pumping capacity to its east-west pipeline, which was affected by attacks during the US-Israeli war on Iran, with the pipeline now able to transport around seven million barrels of oil per day to the Yanbu port on the Red Sea, bypassing the closed Strait of Hormuz. 
The announcement comes after the state-run Saudi Press Agency reported last week that attacks on a pumping station for the East-West pipeline had reduced daily output by 700,000bpd.
The outlet, which cited a source at the Energy Ministry, also reported that attacks on the Manifa and Khurais oilfields had reduced daily capacity by a combined 600,000 barrels.
The report did not attribute blame for the attacks.
Saudi Arabia and other GCC countries such as Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, United Arab Emirates and Qatar witnessed attacks from Iran. 
Tehran said it targeted US assets in the region. Qatar on Friday released footage showing civilian and energy sites hit
title: Saudi Arabia restores East-West pipeline to full capacity after attacks
